recap.analyst:
Ridgeview beat Guanabara FC 3-1. On expected goals it finished 0.25–0.28: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Ridgeview had 53% of the ball. Pass completion RID 85% (164/194), GUA 80% (154/193). Shots 3–4, on target 3–1.

Ridgeview started in a 4-3-3 (low block), Guanabara FC in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: GUA to 4-2-3-1 at 71' (chasing the game); RID to 4-4-2 at 81' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 4': Ridgeview broke the deadlock through N. Fofana. The chance was worth xG 0.07 (about 7 in 100 go in), struck at 100 km/h. Score now RID 1-0 GUA. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: I. Vidal completed the most passes (40); K. Achterberg hit the top speed (33.2 km/h); N. Fofana covered the most ground (6.12 km, a 17.2 km per-90 pace); P. Petit won the most challenges (8).

Discipline: fouls 3–4, yellows 1–0, offsides 0–0. Conditions: sunny, 26°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: What a game at Castellana Arena, Madrid. N. Fofana broke the deadlock in the 4th minute. P. Petit struck in the 6th for Ridgeview. H. Zielinski struck in the 53rd for Guanabara FC. N. Fofana struck in the 78th for Ridgeview. Guanabara FC pushed for a way back, switching to a 4-2-3-1 in the 71st minute, but Ridgeview held firm. The hero: N. Fofana, with 2 goals. At the final whistle, Ridgeview celebrate in front of their fans.
